digest.component_or_area: LLM review operations (CLI, library, MCP interfaces)
propositions: Remove three deprecated single-pass review public entry points: CLI verb 'rebar review', library function rebar.llm.review_ticket wrapper, and MCP tool review_ticket, all deprecated in v0.11.0 and scheduled for v1.0.0 removal.
The internal engine _review_ticket_impl and review_result.schema.json must remain because they have active internal consumers and are still produced by surviving review-code and workflow paths.
Delete three deprecation registry _scheduled rows and append the removal to the historical NOTE block in src/rebar/_deprecations.py without adding a tombstone entry.

Regenerate CLI and MCP reference documentation via scripts (never hand-edit) and repoint review_result.schema.json wiring in OUTPUT_SCHEMAS to review_code (the surviving producer) to keep the every-schema-file-is-wired guard satisfied.

Update or delete references to the three removed surfaces across 19 test files, 24 documentation files, and 42 non-impl code references without breaking the two surviving internal consumers of _review_ticket_impl.
All three public surfaces must be gone while generated docs remain in sync and the full test suite passes with zero failures.
